title: Protect compressor flow margin with tracked override
physicalPurpose: Give minimum-flow margin priority over discharge-pressure production demand without inactive windup or a release bump.
principalTechnique: High selector, external tracking and hysteretic constraint override
objective: Configure a recycle-valve high selector that gives minimum-flow margin priority over discharge-pressure production demand.

simplifications: Local linear pressure and flow-margin dynamics around one compressor operating point
Flow margin is an educational control variable, not a compressor-map surge coordinate
Ideal requested-equals-applied recycle position without valve stiction or rate limit
Three deterministic equivalent plants isolate selector state management
Simulation-only I/O and evidence; no machinery-protection claim

baseline.limitation: Normal pressure control violates margin, while an untracked inactive protection integral may take over late or return with a bump.

change.decision: Accept override only when common-unit direction, quality, tracked inactive state, one takeover, one release and transition-step limits are all proven.

disturbances: Pressure setpoint changes from 8 to 9 bar at 20.0 s
Pressure setpoint returns to 8 bar at 80.0 s
A separate restored run invalidates flow-margin quality

acceptance.window: adjacent samples at takeover and release

abortPredicates: Any required signal is nonfinite, stale, forced, or has invalid quality
Flow margin crosses the zero local-model boundary
Selector authority or restoration is inconsistent
Authority chatters beyond the declared transition count
safety.restorationMode: With invalid margin quality, remove automatic protection authority and track both candidates to the reviewed 30-percent simulated fallback; qualify measurement and valve state before re-enabling.
safety.physicalApprovalRole: authorised compressor controls engineer and responsible machinery engineer
simulationOnlyRestrictions: No physical compressor or recycle valve is operated
The simulated margin is not anti-surge or machinery-protection certification
Physical override requires a reviewed compressor map, instrumentation, trips, valve capacity/fail action, protection topology and explicit experiment approval

video.viewerOutcome: Configure and validate a tracked high-selector override, explain inactive windup, and distinguish control evidence from machinery protection.

learning.context: Three equivalent centrifugal-compressor local models expose discharge pressure, minimum-flow margin and one shared recycle valve.
learning.reason: Unlike split range, two complete control objectives compete for one actuator and equipment margin must have explicit priority over production pressure.
theory: The high selector follows actuator physics because a larger recycle request raises protected margin.
External tracking aligns whichever integral controller is inactive with the selected applied valve before it can receive authority.
A 14-percent takeover and 16-percent release band prevents threshold chatter without redefining the 12-percent protected minimum.
learning.workedPrediction: Closing recycle from 30 to 10 percent predicts 9 bar but zero margin; at least 22 percent recycle preserves 12-percent margin and limits pressure to about 8.4 bar.
practicalPreparation: Verify Simulation evidence, all identities, SP/PV/request units and signs, selector direction, candidates, applied valve, authority, thresholds, quality, timing and limits.
Define minimum margin, violation duration, IAE, takeover/release delay, transition count and valve-step measures before showing results.
learning.baseline: Run normal-only and untracked override through the same pressure demand to retain constraint conflict and inactive-state defects.
learning.change: Track the inactive candidate against selected recycle and use hysteretic takeover and release with valid margin data.
learning.comparison: Hold models, state, controller tuning, demand cycle, thresholds, timing, limits and seed equal while changing only selector and tracking behavior.
learning.validation: Require tracked margin at least 11.5 percent, exactly one takeover and release, no chatter, at most one-percentage-point transition steps, and explicit unavailable fallback for invalid quality.
learning.explanation: Pressure is sacrificed because equipment margin owns priority; tracking removes stored inactive integral mismatch and hysteresis prevents repeated threshold switching.
learning.transfer: Use override for competing controllers on one actuator; the next lesson changes controller parameters because gravity-tank dynamics vary with operating level.
